## InkOS Analytics/Reports Page — Deep Structure Map

### 1. **Routes Under `app/(app)/reports/**`**

| Route | Page File | Layout | Metadata Title |
|-------|-----------|--------|-----------------|
| `/reports` | `/app/(app)/reports/page.tsx` | `/app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx` | "Reports — InkOS" |
| `/reports/revenue` | `revenue/page.tsx` | shared layout | "Revenue Report — InkOS" |
| `/reports/artists` | `artists/page.tsx` | shared layout | "Artist Performance — InkOS" |
| `/reports/clients` | `clients/page.tsx` | shared layout | "Client Analytics — InkOS" |
| `/reports/bookings` | `bookings/page.tsx` | shared layout | "Booking Analytics — InkOS" |
| `/reports/inventory` | `inventory/page.tsx` | shared layout | "Inventory Report — InkOS" |
| `/reports/ai` | `ai/page.tsx` | shared layout | "AI Usage — InkOS" |

**Key Details:**
- All routes require `studio_owner` persona (via `requirePersona()`)
- `/reports` redirects to `/reports/revenue`
- Layout uses `PageShell` + `PageHeader` + `PageViews` pattern
- Each tab route renders `Suspense` boundary with skeleton fallback

---

### 2. **API Endpoints Under `app/api/reports/**`**

| Route | File | Returns | Key Fields |
|-------|------|---------|------------|
| `/api/reports/revenue` | `revenue/route.ts` | `{ timeline, kpis }` | totalRevenue, avgSessionValue, deposits, tips, sessionsCompleted |
| `/api/reports/artists` | `artists/route.ts` | `{ leaderboard }` | artistId, revenue, sessions, noShows, avgTipPct, noShowRate |
| `/api/reports/clients` | `clients/route.ts` | `{ ...kpis }` | totalClients, newClients, returningClients, avgLtv, retentionRate |
| `/api/reports/bookings` | `bookings/route.ts` | `{ kpis, timeline, heatmap, serviceRanking }` | completed, noShows, cancelled, rates, 7x24 heatmap |
| `/api/reports/inventory` | `inventory/route.ts` | `{ kpis, categoryBreakdown }` | totalItems, lowStockCount, cogsConsumed, category stats |
| `/api/reports/ai` | `ai/route.ts` | `{ kpis, modelBreakdown, monthlyTrend }` | total, cost, tokens, avgRating, model usage |

**Common Features:** Rate limiting (`authedRatelimit`), auth check (owner/admin only), Zod validation, Supabase queries, optional date range filters (`from`/`to`)

---

### 3. **Components Under `components/reports/**`**

| Component | Purpose | Key Props |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| `ReportsTabNav.tsx` | Tab navigation for 6 tabs (Revenue, Artists, Clients, Bookings, Inventory, AI Usage). Uses `usePathname()` to detect active tab. | None; reads pathname |
| `RevenueReportClient.tsx` | Client-side revenue dashboard with KPI cards, toggleable grouping (day/week/month), area + bar charts. **CSV export** inline. | None (fetches `/api/reports/revenue`) |
| `ArtistsReportClient.tsx` | Leaderboard table ranking artists by revenue. Shows sessions, no-show %, tip %. | None (fetches `/api/reports/artists`) |
| `ClientsReportClient.tsx` | 6 KPI cards: total, new, returning, inactive, LTV, retention rate. No charts. | None (fetches `/api/reports/clients`) |
| `BookingsReportClient.tsx` | 6 KPIs + timeline bar chart + heatmap (day × hour) + service ranking table. | None (fetches `/api/reports/bookings`) |
| `InventoryReportClient.tsx` | 3 KPIs (total items, low stock, COGS) + category breakdown table (sorted by value). | None (fetches `/api/reports/inventory`) |
| `AiUsageReportClient.tsx` | 4 KPIs + monthly cost bar chart + model breakdown table. | None (fetches `/api/reports/ai`) |
| `RechartsAreaChart.tsx` | Reusable Recharts area chart. Respects theme via `useChartTheme()`. Gradient fill, tooltip formatting. | data, dataKey, label, formatValue, color, theme |
| `RechartsBarChart.tsx` | Reusable Recharts bar chart. Same theming as area chart. | data, dataKey, label, formatValue, color, theme |

---

### 4. **Chart/KPI Components**

- **KpiCard** (`components/shared/KpiCard.tsx`): Displays label, value (with CountUp animation), optional delta trend badge, sparkline, icon. Used by all 6 tabs.
- **RechartsAreaChart** + **RechartsBarChart**: Both use `recharts` library, theme-aware via `lib/charts/theme`, margin-constrained (h=200px).
- **DataState** (`components/shared/DataState.tsx`): Generic wrapper handling loading, error, empty states. All client components render within it.
- **Badge** + **Card** + **CardHeader/CardTitle/CardContent**: shadcn/ui layout primitives for sections.

---

### 5. **Page Header & Tab Navigation**

- **Layout file** (`app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx`) renders:
  - `<PageHeader title="Reports" description="Studio analytics and performance insights" />`
  - `<ReportsTabNav />` (6 underline-styled tabs)
- **PageHeader component** (`components/shared/PageHeader.tsx`): Breadcrumb-capable, back link, title (Instrument Serif), description. Supports `breadcrumb` prop but **not actively used** by /reports routes.
- **Tab activation**: `ReportsTabNav` uses `usePathname()` to highlight active route.

---

### 6. **Sidebar vs. Page Title Discrepancy**

- **Sidebar label** (`components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` line 243–244): `label: 'Analytics'`, `href: '/reports'`
- **Page title** (layout.tsx line 12): `title: "Reports"`
- **Why the mismatch?** Sidebar groups items by feature area ("OPERATIONS: Payments / Inventory / Forms / Analytics"). The nav-config comment explicitly notes: *"Sidebar label 'Analytics' — route /reports unchanged"*. This is intentional UX: sidebar uses domain label; page uses primary action label.

**"Team" breadcrumb mystery:** Searched `/reports/artists` metadata and code—no breadcrumb rendered. The "Artist Performance" title doesn't show "Team" in the page header. This may be a legacy note or intended future feature.

---

### 7. **Date-Range Picker**

- **File**: `components/ui/date-range-picker.tsx` (fully implemented, ready-to-use)
- **Features**: Dual-calendar popover with 7 presets (Today, Yesterday, Last 7/30 days, This/Last month, Last 3 months). Custom preset support.
- **Exports**: `DateRangePicker`, `DateRange` interface
- **Status**: **EXISTS** — not currently wired into reports tabs (they use `group_by` enum instead of date filtering), but available for future integration.

---

### 8. **CSV Export Utility**

- **Per-tab**: Only **Revenue** tab implements CSV export (inline in `RevenueReportClient.tsx` lines 48–62)
- **Method**: Collects timeline data → CSV rows → `Blob` → `a.download` → click
- **Not shared**: Each tab would need its own export logic. No shared utility module found.
- **Filename pattern**: `revenue-report-${groupBy}.csv`

---

### 9. **Tab-to-Chart Mapping**

| Tab | Page File | Charts/KPIs | Data Fetch |
|-----|-----------|------------|-----------|
| **Revenue** | `revenue/page.tsx` | 5 KPIs + Area Chart (timeline) + Bar Chart (by period) | `GET /api/reports/revenue?group_by=day\|week\|month` |
| **Artists** | `artists/page.tsx` | Leaderboard table (ranked by revenue) | `GET /api/reports/artists` |
| **Clients** | `clients/page.tsx` | 6 KPI cards (no charts) | `GET /api/reports/clients` |
| **Bookings** | `bookings/page.tsx` | 6 KPIs + Bar Chart (timeline) + Heatmap (day×hour) + Service Ranking table | `GET /api/reports/bookings` |
| **Inventory** | `inventory/page.tsx` | 3 KPIs + Category Breakdown table | `GET /api/reports/inventory` |
| **AI** | `ai/page.tsx` | 4 KPIs + Bar Chart (monthly cost) + Model Breakdown table | `GET /api/reports/ai` |

---

### **Key Dependencies**
- `@tanstack/react-query` (all tabs; 5min staleTime)
- `recharts` (dynamic-loaded area/bar charts)
- `date-fns` (date-range-picker, formatting)
- `sonner` (sidebar pin toast notifications)
- `lucide-react` (icons)
